items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I know Merritt is over there in Biloxi now. Merritt has been in Biloxi for years. [INTERVIEWEE] Since about that time off and on I think. Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, we'd like to take a crazy ocean, work a circle all around, come in by Pensacola, by Mobile and ride on in town and play everything in between.
Well, I know Merritt is over there in Biloxi now. Merritt has been in Biloxi for years.
Since about that time off and on I think. Yeah.
